pricing_text: Priced per second of output video, by resolution: **480p** at **$0.08**/sec, **720p** at **$0.14**/sec, **1080p** at **$0.25**/sec. A 5-second 480p clip costs **$0.40**; 720p costs **$0.70**. Cost scales linearly with duration. No input images or references, so no per-image charges apply.
notes: usd للأرخص (480p)؛ الافتراضي في المخطط 720p = $0.14/ث. تنبيه: by_resolution في pricing_parsed بملف fal-launch.json كان معكوسًا — الصحيح من النص: 480p 0.08 / 720p 0.14 / 1080p 0.25. المدة 1–15 ث.
